The old rancho had horses and a big barn.
We visited a family rancho in California.
The road leads to a quiet rancho by the river.
note: Rare in English; "ranch" is far more common.

examples: My grandma has rheumatism in her knees.

Don't lie down after eating if you have reflux.
Coffee makes my reflux worse.

meaning_hint: title of a leader or chief in Persia, India, Afghanistan
examples: The village sardar settled the argument.
Everyone respected the old sardar.
The sardar spoke to the visitors first.
People asked the sardar for advice.
note: Rare in English; "chief" or "leader" is more common.
